query: My CASE CX350B was built in 2010. Which lower radiator hose does the catalog show?
response_text:
The CASE US catalog does **not identify a specific hose as the “lower radiator hose.”** For the **CASE CX350B Crawler Excavator Tier 3 (NA)**, assembly **02-04 – Radiator and Connections** lists these radiator-hose entries:

- **KSH1028** — quantity 1  
- **KSH1030** — quantity 1  
- **KSH1031** — quantity 1  
- **KSH1032** — quantity 1  
- **KSH1065** — quantity 2  

The catalog’s targeted searches for **“lower radiator hose”** and **“water hose”** returned no direct match, so I would not safely promote one of those numbers as the lower hose. Assembly evidence: [https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra312cxb/crawler-excavator-tier-3-na/engine/radiator-and-connections/cn/10462E54-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/6EDA6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]. The catalog match covers **May 2008–November 2018**, including your stated 2010 build, but PIN-specific fitment was not established.

*US catalog evidence is partial; exact lower-hose identification remains unverified. Is the hose you mean the large hose running from the bottom of the radiator to the water pump?

query: Find the bucket-link spherical bearing for my CASE CX130 built in 2005.
response_text:
For a **2005 CASE CX130**, the North American catalog does **not identify a separately serviced bucket-link spherical bearing**.

The inspected bucket-link assemblies list:

- **160724A1** — bushing, **65 mm ID × 80 mm OD × 65 mm long**, quantity 2  
- **150123A1** — bushing, **70 mm ID × 85 mm OD × 70 mm long**, quantity 2  
- The bucket-link callout itself is marked **NSS (not sold separately)** in both the standard and heavy-duty linkage assemblies. [Standard assembly: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/bucket-linkage/cn/18D5CF56-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6] [Heavy-duty assembly: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/crawler-excavators/naer24cra308cx/case-crawler-excavator-north-america/chassis/bucket-linkage/cn/DF4C315A-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]

A catalog search for “bearing” did not find a bucket-link spherical bearing, although that search was bounded and does not prove one cannot exist elsewhere. [Bearing search: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/dc/searchInModel/part-description?modelCode=FFD96496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6&paramSearch=bearing&regionCode=NA]

Neither lists a spherical bearing; both list bucket-link callout 2 as NSS (not sold separately) and use bushings 160724A1 (65 mm ID × 80 mm OD × 65 mm L, quantity 2) and 150123A1 (70 mm ID × 85 mm OD × 70 mm L, quantity 2). A bounded catalog search for “bearing” returned 62 matches, including bearings in other machine systems, but no bucket-link spherical bearing. This does not establish catalog-wide absence beyond the searched scope. query: Which master brake cylinder is listed for a 1985 CASE W20C?
response_text:
For a **1985 CASE W20C**, the catalog lists two possible hydraulic master cylinders, depending on the installed brake actuator:

- **N8469** — used with actuator **L107985/L112959**; 200 mm stroke. [Assembly 7-58](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l107985-and-l112959-brake-actuators/cn/53488E5D-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6)
- **N8695** — used with actuator **L113007**. [Assembly 7-68](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l113007-brake-actuator/cn/4D9B6E81-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6)

Both assemblies reference repair kit **N8937**. The correct choice requires matching the actuator number on the machine.

*US CASE catalog evidence; exact fitment is unverified. Confirm the installed actuator number before ordering.

Potential master-cylinder assembly N8469 is listed in inspected assembly 7-58, “L107985 and L112959 Brake Actuators,” quantity 1. It is a 200 mm-stroke hydraulic master cylinder for the brake actuator; the catalog says to order repair kit N8937 for service. Potential master-cylinder assembly N8695 is listed in inspected assembly 7-68, “L113007 Brake Actuator,” quantity 1. It is a hydraulic master cylinder for the brake actuator; the same figure lists repair kit N8937, including specified seals and related service parts. [assembly https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l113007-brake-actuator/cn/4D9B6E81-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6]

These are alternative actuator-specific findings, not confirmed interchangeable parts: N8469 belongs to the L107985/L112959 actuator configuration, while N8695 belongs to L113007. No serial/PIN applicability qualification was displayed on these rows, so the machine’s installed brake-actuator number or physical configuration is needed to select one.

The inspected catalog also lists N9055 as a separate air-chamber assembly containing master-cylinder components within the L107985/L112959 actuator figure; it should not be treated as the hydraulic master-cylinder assembly without confirming the requested component scope. NSS components are not sold separately, and some listed parts are included only in kit N8937. query: I need the starter motor for a 1992 CASE 1845C.
response_text:
For a **1992 CASE 1845C**, the US CASE catalog shows these starter options:

- **86982709** — 12 V, 2.5 kW starter motor, shown in starter assembly 04-01A ([assembly](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader-north-america/electrical-systems/starter-assy/cn/1F3A315A-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D1CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6); [product](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/alternators-starters/starters/starter-motor/p/86982709)).
- **86982709R** — remanufactured version, with **86982709C** listed as the core/return number ([assembly](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader-north-america/electrical-systems/starter-assy/cn/1F3A315A-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D1CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6); [product](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/alternators-starters/starters/reman-starter/p/86982709R), [core](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/alternators-starters/repair-parts/core-starter/p/86982709C)).
- Earlier listing **A170746** directs to **1987559C1**, but both are marked no longer available ([assembly](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/light-equipment/skid-steer-loaders/naes77ski007uni-loader/case-uni-loader-skid-steer-loader-north-america/electrical-systems/starter-assy/cn/E9638B80-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D1CB6496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6)).

The two catalog starter assemblies overlap but represent different configurations, so confirm the machine’s serial/PIN and compare the mounting, tooth count, and electrical connections before ordering.

*US CASE catalog evidence only; exact serial-specific fitment is unverified. Is your 1845C’s serial/PIN available to distinguish the two starter configurations?

query: Please find the pickup reel bearing for a 2006 Case IH RBX463 round baler.
response_text:
The pickup reel bearing for a **2006 Case IH RBX463 round baler** is:

- **CNH part number:** **54770**
- **Description:** Ball bearing
- **Dimensions:** **27.33 mm ID × 47.092 mm OD × 12.827 mm wide**
- **Catalog quantity:** 12
- **Pickup-reel callout:** 4

The bearing appears consistently in the inspected RBX463 pickup/reel assemblies: [assembly 13.380](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/balers/round-balers/naad72rou022rbx/case-ih-round-baler/feeder/18m-single-cam-wide-pickup-reel/cn/44B3E05E-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/6EE06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6), [13.385](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/balers/round-balers/naad72rou022rbx/case-ih-round-baler/feeder/18m-dual-cam-wide-pickup-reel/cn/DE97D55C-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/6EE06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6), [13.431](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/balers/round-balers/naad72rou022rbx/case-ih-round-baler/feeder/2m-wide-pickup-reel-curved-pickup-tines/cn/B83F315A-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/6EE06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6), and [13.432](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/balers/round-balers/naad72rou022rbx/case-ih-round-baler/feeder/2m-wide-pickup-reel-rotor/cn/8FF2DC52-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/6EE06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6). The [part listing is here](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/category/bearings-bushings/bearings/ball-bearing/p/54770).

Do not confuse it with the separate bearing housing, **CNH 54695**, shown as callout 3.

*US CNH catalog evidence; the catalog shows multiple pickup configurations, so confirm the PIN/serial applicability before ordering. Catalog quantity is not stock availability.*

query: What is included in the tailgate cylinder seal kit for a 2004 Case IH RBX562?
response_text:
For a **2004 Case IH RBX562**, the CNH US catalog shows **two possible tailgate-lift cylinder seal kits**:

- **Old-style cylinder:** seal kit **86586336**, callout 14, used with cylinder **86637318**. The associated assembly lists the piston, rod, backup, and wiper seals individually, but the catalog does **not explicitly state the complete contents of the kit**. [Assembly](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/balers/round-balers/naad72rou022rbx/case-ih-round-baler/hydraulic-system/hydraulic-cylinder-tailgate-lift-old-style/cn/C9C4E746-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/72E06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6) · [Product](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/category/seals-o-rings/seal-kits/seal-kit/p/86586336)
- **New-style cylinder:** seal kit **87025443**, callout 14, used with cylinder **87019624**. This is a double-acting cylinder with a **31.75 mm rod** and **685.8 mm stroke**. The catalog likewise does not provide a definitive itemized kit-content list. [Assembly](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/na/balers/round-balers/naad72rou022rbx/case-ih-round-baler/hydraulic-system/hydraulic-cylinder-tailgate-lift-new-style/cn/C8CDE746-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/72E06496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6) · [Product](https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/caseih/category/hydraulics/cylinders/seal-kit/p/87025443)

*The catalog does not establish a serial break, so confirm whether your baler has the old-style or new-style cylinder—ideally by matching the cylinder part number or production-date marking—before ordering.
